cfg.bindingEvents: parameters first in declaration order, then catch/local events as original reached declaration order; events are immutable data copies, not proof and not emitted runtime operations
cfg.blockAllocation: deterministic first-discovery FIFO: process block0; process each block to its terminating transfer; create destination at first transfer discovery and append to queue. No block pruning/coalescing. Every reached standalone/try/catch/finally region gets its own block even empty finally; one final escape block. A normal nested block inside finally gets an explicit parent continuation block at statement index+1, even at parent end; there is no normal-try join block.
cfg.blockLabels: Node entry label implicit; nonentry ^bb<ordinal>; C++ matches block ordinal in region order, not textual labels
cfg.catch: named catch binds its one current carrier argument with original unknown BindingId/type/writable/ranges; no hidden original-payload slot. A catch rethrow bypasses the same catch and passes that current value through finally; bindingless catch creates no binding and may throw another in-scope i32 reference.
cfg.completion: only terminal language throw plus normal finally completion are admitted. No return/normal try completion/assignment/abrupt finally semantics are inferred from these witnesses.
cfg.edgeOrder: global edge ordinal in block processing/terminator emission order; every cf.br has exactly one edge record; no edge record for propagate
cfg.entry: allocate block0 for function root, original parameters in declaration order, then fuel1 once; root region range is original HIR root range
cfg.finally: reached with pending [{last throw scope,index}] and exactly one carrier argument; execute original alias/block body normally, then forward that same pending carrier to escape. Empty finally still has its own real block and outgoing cf.br. Finally cannot see its sibling catch binding; inherited outer i32 parameters/aliases remain available by valid dominance. No finally means no synthetic finally block.
cfg.frame: the one try frame is pushed in arm try on entry; its catch is eligible only while leaving try. Catch entry disables its own handler and records arm catch. Finally is arm finally, has no catch-local visibility and cannot throw/return/try in this subset.
cfg.lexicalBlocks: outside finally, a standalone block must end in terminal throw; inside finally, a standalone block completes normally and gets its own block and an explicit continuation in its parent. Pending carrier is a block argument across enter/resume transfers. Inherited definitions are immutable aliases and remain private inside shared SSA.
cfg.planning: preflight all HIR and Source subset, prove terminal try/catch and normally completing finally, then construct logical route graph before serializing any output
cfg.statementOrder: within each region, original source statement order; alias declarations record events; standalone block/try enters child; terminal throw consumes its expression once and ends the current block; any remaining source tail is capability
cfg.terminal: all blocks reachable from entry, single successor except final escape, all source regions/statements covered once, all SSA values dominated and typed, no live fallthrough, exact one escape propagate
cfg.throw: i32 bindingRead produces pack; unknown catch read reuses its current carrier directly. If current try arm has catch, transfer to that catch before its own finally; catch accepts one carrier argument even without binding. Otherwise pass the whole saved carrier through the own finally if present, then escape.
cfg.valueAllocation: global function ordinal: allocate entry parameters first; allocate each pack result at its emission before destination discovery; allocate destination carrier block argument when that block is created; no register for references/local aliases. Node names %v<ordinal>. Declaration/result traversal re-identifies values independently in C++ regardless printer names.

fieldTypes.binding: kind parameter|catch|local; position declaration statement index or0 for parameter/catch; value is the actual aliased ValueId; from_binding empty for parameter/catch, exact initializer BindingId for local; type/writable/range exact HIR binding; initializer_range [] for parameter/catch or [Range] for local

Entry and escape frames=[]; region/continuation inside a try/catch/finally inherits the current arm. pending=[] at entry, try/outside-finally regions and catch (its incoming throw is handled); finally and its normal children/continuations and escape have pending=[{scope,statement}] for the last user throw. parameters ordered ValueId[]; range original owning region range, escape uses function range Escape scope is the original function root ScopeId and position=0; its carrier block-argument range is the complete function range.
fieldTypes.edge: kind enter|resume|catch|finally|escape; scope/statement identify structural entry/resumption or last user throw origin; arguments [] or [whole carrier ValueId]; range compound statement range for enter/resume, last throw statement range for catch/finally/escape

fieldTypes.frame: scope is the region containing its try; try_scope required; catch_scope/catch_binding/finally_scope empty when absent (catch_scope nonempty and catch_binding empty means bindingless catch)
fieldTypes.range: exact {start:i64,end:i64} dictionary; original UTF16 positions, not Core text offsets
fieldTypes.value: definition parameter|blockArgument|pack; type is original i32 TypeId or CorePayloadTypeId; range parameter binding range, carrier block original region range, or pack operand range respectively

cf.br.rule: one matching edge record; same function, exact argument type/count/value; no entry target, no cycles, no hidden exceptional destination

local-alias.rule: every reached local declaration has exactly one binding event mapping to initializer current SSA ValueId, preserving permission/type/source metadata; no invented copy/store/load operation; no new SSA register

tsfg_core.fuel.rule: exactly once at function entry as its first operation, event=1:i32; anchor entire original function range; no loop/event2 in this subset; no user-exception edge on fuel/trap/Execution Abort

tsfg_exception.propagate.rule: only in unique function escape block; anchor last reached user throw statement, including current catch rethrow; no conversion/repack/func.return

selection.algorithmic: selection uses validated structure/types only; never case ID, path, source text/hash, fixture membership, HIR hash or SourceOrigin identity

selection.identifiers: plain ASCII identifier spellings [A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*; Unicode remains valid in comments/source trivia with exact UTF16 mapping; escaped/nonASCII declaration/read names require a later capability tranche

selection.parameterPresence: all undefined/null/optional/default flags false; exact source ranges retained; initializers null or aligned all-null array retained
selection.reachability: every original statement/body region must be reached once by the reconstructed straight-line completion path; unreachable tails/handlers and repeated region visits are capability before output
selection.sourceProfile: minimal-integers-v3 with exact pinned declarations and explicit unchanged Windows-x86_64-msvc target
statements: local i32 initialized by one direct i32 bindingRead
terminal try with optional catch and optional finally

unsupported: uninitialized local, unknown local alias, groups/constants/operators/typeTest
